parts.label: Sheet hosts
parts.help: Each sheet has a Pip by its close button, holding up that sheet’s sign.

parts.label: Status faces in lists
parts.help: Pip faces in Scheduled and Memory lists follow each owner’s exact status-key table.

parts.label: Working orbit
parts.help: Pip sits in the middle of the Orbit while work runs.

parts.label: Plans
parts.help: Pip holds up a plan that is ready for review, and naps beside a build that waits for its window.

parts.label: Wand menu
parts.help: Pip holds the wand at the top of Assistant capabilities.

parts.label: Empty lists
parts.help: A resting Pip where there is nothing yet.

parts.label: State faces
parts.help: Working shows thinking dots, done is happy, needs you wonders, failed says oops, waiting sleeps.

parts.label: Watches
parts.help: Rest the pointer on a control and the sheet’s Pip watches it.

parts.label: Wonders while typing
parts.help: Big eyes while you write in a sheet’s fields.

parts.label: Cheers
parts.help: Happy, and a hop, when you press a sheet’s main button.

parts.label: Oops
parts.help: A worried face when a button can’t be used yet.

parts.label: Gaze
parts.help: The sheet’s Pip looks where the pointer is, and keeps looking there when it stops.

parts.label: Blinks
parts.help: Now and then, never two Pips at once.

parts.label: Sway and physics
parts.help: The sheet’s Pip swings a little, as if a hand held it, and drops in when a sheet opens.

parts.label: Blinks between faces
parts.help: A face changes behind a quick blink, the way it does in onboarding.

parts.label: Thinking dots
parts.help: The working face’s three dots bob in turn.

parts.label: Idle life
parts.help: Small resting acts while Pip is visible and the interface is idle.

parts.label: Seat colours
parts.help: Each helper wears its seat’s colour. Off: every Pip is the theme’s Pip.

parts.label: Role props
parts.help: Crown, hard hat, glasses, gavel, jester cap, page, pennant and the rest.

parts.label: Strings
parts.help: Off: Pip floats without its strings.

parts.label: Cheeks and shine
parts.help: Friendly and Glass only.

parts.label: Setup world life
parts.help: Look-specific chapter worlds and their bounded ambient life during setup.

parts.label: Pip talks in setup
parts.help: Pip speaks in the current look’s short setup voice, under the master mute.

parts.label: Pip chirps in the app
parts.help: A small chirp with each face a sheet’s Pip makes, in the theme’s voice. Starts off.

parts.label: Setup music
parts.help: The current setup chapter’s quiet, gesture-gated background music.

claim_boundary: Static admitted parts contract. JavaScript registry/API reconciliation and native Settings evidence are separate.
